title: Select Distinct Cities
description: Retrieve unique city names from the Customers table using SELECT DISTINCT.

data.text: Write a query to retrieve a unique list of cities from the `Customers` table.

data.title: SQL Solution
Explanation
data.text: DISTINCT eliminates duplicate values from the result set. Use it when you only need unique values for a column or combination of columns. DISTINCT applies to the entire selected row when multiple columns are used.
